notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Basal Sliver by paying {B}.
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Basal Sliver dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Basal Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
